kindergarten.title: Kindergarten & Early Years School
kindergarten.article:
Kindergarten & Early Years School

Nurturing Wonder, Curiosity, and Potential (Ages 3–6)

Welcome to the Kindergarten at Laiser Hill Academy—a vibrant, joyful space designed specifically for children aged 3 to 6 years. Here, learning is a magical journey of discovery, play, and growth. We believe that these early years lay the groundwork for a lifetime of confidence, character, and academic success.

Our Academic Structure

We follow the Kenyan Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC), focusing on developing key foundational skills through interactive and learner-centered experiences. Our structured learning path guides children seamlessly through every stage of early childhood:

Baby Class (Playgroup): Our entry-level program, carefully crafted to introduce young learners to social play, gentle routines, and hands-on discovery.

Pre-Primary 1 (PP1): Expanding language, numeracy, and foundational social competencies through guided activities.

Pre-Primary 2 (PP2): Preparing confident, curious children for a smooth transition into Lower Primary.

Our Educational Philosophy

"Each child is valued as strong, capable, and resilient, with an innate ability for endless wonder fueled by a desire for knowledge."

Young children possess deep curiosity and unlimited potential to thrive as they begin to explore their expanding world and understand their place within it. Our Kindergarten program focuses on learning through social inclusion and collaborative group work to achieve remarkable outcomes in early childhood education.

In our Kindergarten environment, each child is an equal participant. As they develop confidence through play-based learning, young children understand the value of their contribution and actively seek feedback from teachers—asking questions to refine their communication skills in a dynamic, multi-faceted process.

Exceptional Care & Balanced Daily Schedule

We know that for young children to learn, they must first feel safe, loved, and fully supported.

Dedicated Care Teams: Our classrooms are led by highly qualified early childhood educators, complemented by attentive, loving nannies who ensure every child’s personal, hygiene, and emotional needs are met with warmth.

Thoughtful Hours: Our daily academic and play routine runs from 8:30 AM to 2:00 PM, balancing focused learning with rest, snacks, and social play.

Vibrant Enrichment & Play

A child's world expands through diverse experiences. Beyond the classroom, our pupils enjoy rich, complementary extracurricular activities designed to develop motor skills, creativity, and joy:

Arts, Painting & Storytelling: Expressing imagination and building vocabulary through creative arts and rich narratives.

Swimming & Skating: Building coordination, balance, and physical confidence under safe, qualified instruction.

Extensive Playgrounds: Safe, green, and spacious outdoor areas built for active play, exploration, and making lifelong friends.

Movie & Media Sessions: Fun, age-appropriate visual storytelling sessions that stimulate imagination and group discussion.

At Laiser Hill Academy, our little angels do not just start their education—they begin a journey To Greater Heights.

primary.title: Primary & Junior School
primary.article:
Primary & Junior School

Building All-Round Competencies for Future Leaders (Ages 6–14)

At Laiser Hill Academy, our Primary and Junior School offers a dynamic educational environment where young learners transition seamlessly from pre-school into a world of expanded knowledge, skill acquisition, and personal growth. We provide an enriching curriculum designed to cultivate curious, confident, and well-rounded individuals ready to take on global challenges. 

Our Academic Structure & Curriculum

We fully implement the Kenyan Competency-Based Education (CBE) system, focusing on practical skills, critical thinking, values, and talent identification alongside academic excellence. 

Our primary school structure serves learners aged 6 to 14 years:

Primary School (Grades 1 – 6): Building strong foundations in literacy, numeracy, science, digital skills, and creative arts while nurturing core competencies and problem-solving abilities. 

Junior School (Grades 7 – 9): Broadening academic horizons with specialized subjects, practical exploration, and career guidance as students transition into young adolescence. 

Experienced Educators & Caring Support Staff

The backbone of our academic excellence is our highly qualified, well-equipped teaching faculty, trained in modern CBE instruction and child-centered methodologies. Our educators work side-by-side with dedicated non-teaching and administrative staff to ensure every child receives personalized academic mentoring, moral guidance, and physical care throughout the school day.

Holistic Development: Clubs, Technology & Sports

We believe true education goes beyond textbooks. Laiser Hill Academy offers a rich ecosystem of co-curricular activities to ensure every pupil discovers and sharpens their unique talents:

Active Clubs & Societies

Service & Leadership: Scouts, St. John Ambulance, and Red Cross.

Environmental & STEAM: Wildlife Club, along with cutting-edge Coding & Robotics classes to prepare students for the digital world.

Martial Arts: Karate and Taekwondo for discipline, self-defense, and fitness.

World-Class Sports Facilities

Our expansive grounds feature dedicated spaces for:

Football, Basketball, and racquets courts.

Biking tracks and smooth skating areas for active outdoor fun.

Chess and scrabble

Arts & Entertainment

Our spacious Social Hall serves as the creative hub of the school—hosting drama productions, art and design exhibitions, music practice, and vibrant student entertainment sessions.

Exceptional Student Welfare & Services

Healthy, Balanced Nutrition

Growing minds require optimal nutrition. Our school dining service provides delicious, well-balanced meals and snacks throughout the day, freshly prepared to keep energy levels high and focus sharp.Free Complimentary Transport

To ease the daily commute for parents, Laiser Hill Academy provides safe, reliable, and free school transport covering major pickup and drop-off routes across Ongata Rongai, Kiserian, and Ngong towns.

“At Laiser Hill Academy Primary & Junior School, we don't just teach subjects—we nurture capabilities, build character, and inspire learners to reach To Greater Heights.”

senior.title: Senior School
senior.article:
Senior School

Developing Visionary Leaders, Scholars, and Champions

Welcome to Laiser Hill Academy Senior School—a premier center for academic rigor, character development, and holistic excellence. Designed for young men and women preparing for higher education and global careers, our Senior School offers a supportive, high-performing environment that fosters leadership, critical thinking, and self-reliance.

We welcome both boys and girls, offering flexible enrollment choices:

Day Schooling (with free daily transport covering Ongata Rongai, Kiserian, and Ngong towns).

Boarding Schooling (providing a secure, structured, and nurturing "home away from home" that promotes disciplined study and camaraderie).

Academic Pathways: CBE Pioneer Class & 8-4-4

Laiser Hill Academy offers dual, cutting-edge pathways tailored to meet national curriculum transitions seamlessly:

Senior School (CBE): Home to our pioneer cohort across Grades 10, 11, and 12, engaging students in specialized learning tracks focused on career readiness, research, and technical innovation.

National Examinations (8-4-4): Delivering intensive, high-yield academic preparation for Form 3 and Form 4 KCSE candidates.

Modern Learning Infrastructure & Facilities

Our Senior School is equipped with modern educational technology and quiet spaces designed for deep focus and collaborative innovation:

Smart Classrooms: Interactive smartboards and modern audio-visual technology bring complex concepts to life.

Advanced Science & ICT Labs: Fully resourced laboratories for Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Computer Science to power hands-on experimentation, coding, and scientific enquiry.

Quiet Library & Study Lounges: A comprehensive library and peaceful, dedicated spaces ideal for peer group discussions, research, and structured self-study.

A Heritage of National Champions & Creative Arts

At Laiser Hill Academy, talent is cultivated with the same intensity as academic subjects. Our students excel locally, nationally, and internationally across performance arts, sports, and intellectual competitions.

Performing Arts & Co-Curricular Excellence

National Drama Champions: Our state-of-the-art Social Hall serves as the incubator for award-winning creative talent. Laiser Hill has consistently reached the National Drama Festivals every year, winning Best National Play (2015) and Best Modern Dance (2023). 

Global Exposure & STEM: Active representation and accolades in Debate, Science Fairs, and the World Scholar’s Cup at national and international levels.

Unrivaled Sporting Legacy

Laiser Hill Academy boasts some of the finest sports facilities and coaching programs in East Africa:

Basketball (The Pinnacle of Excellence): Widely recognized as the ultimate high school basketball powerhouse in the region, boasting 10 National Championships and 7 East Africa (FEASSSA) Trophies. 

Rugby: A dominant force on the pitch, having secured 2 National Titles and 1 East Africa Trophy. 

Football: High-performance football training backed by 1 National Championship Trophy.

Swimming: We have produced best swimmers every and nationals levels.

Chess and scrabble

Badminton, lawn tennis and table tennis

Pastoral Care, Guidance & Spiritual Growth

We believe that high academic achievement requires a balanced mind and strong moral grounding:

Guidance & Counseling Department: Professional, compassionate counselors dedicated to mental well-being, adolescent mentorship, and personal development.

Spiritual Leadership: Dedicated chaplaincy and spiritual directors providing moral instruction, prayer services, and spiritual guidance for both Christian and Muslim students in an inclusive environment.

Join Laiser Hill Academy Senior School—where academic brilliance, athletic mastery, and creative expression converge to lift young minds To Greater Heights.

international.title: International School
international.article:
Laiser Hill International School

Globally Recognized Excellence: British Curriculum (Pearson Edexcel)

Welcome to Laiser Hill International School, where global academic standards meet individual student success. Following the prestigious British International Curriculum, our school is fully accredited by Pearson Edexcel to administer official international examinations for both IGCSE and International Advanced Level (IAL) qualifications. 

We welcome both boys and girls into a supportive academic ecosystem designed for university readiness and global opportunities, offering flexible enrollment options:

Day Schooling (with free, dedicated transport across Ongata Rongai, Kiserian, and Ngong towns).

Boarding Schooling (a secure, structured, and nurturing environment that fosters discipline, independent study, and lifelong friendships).

Academic Pathways: Entry Points & Examination Structure

Our curriculum is designed to accommodate both continuing international students and learners transitioning from the Kenyan education system:

IGCSE Program (Years 8 – 11)

Often referred to as O-Level qualifications, our IGCSE path spans four years, culminating in official Pearson Edexcel examinations written during the May/June examination series at the end of Year 11:

Pre-KJSEA Transitions: Learners from the Kenyan system can seamlessly transition into Year 8 or Year 9 prior to their national assessment.

Post-KJSEA Transitions: Learners who have completed their KJSEA assessments join directly at Year 10.

Subjects Offered at IGCSE:

Mathematics, English, Kiswahili, French

Chemistry, Physics, Biology

Geography, History, Religious Studies, Business Studies

Information and Communication Technology (ICT)

International A-Level Program (Years 12 – 13)

Upon completing IGCSE, students progress to our rigorous Advanced Level program:

Year 12: Advanced Subsidiary (AS Level)

Year 13: Advanced Level Certificate (A2 Level)

Modular Flexibility: A-Level examinations are structured modularly (unit-wise), providing students the strategy and flexibility to take examinations across the October, January, or May series.

Subjects Offered at A-Level:

Mathematics, English, Law, Economics, Business

Geography, History

Physics, Chemistry, Biology

Information and Communication Technology (ICT)

Modern Learning Infrastructure & Facilities

Our international department is backed by 21st-century technology and quiet study spaces built for research, collaboration, and high academic output:

Smart Classrooms: Interactive smartboards and modern audio-visual tools facilitate interactive, global-standard instruction.

Advanced Science & ICT Labs: Dedicated, fully resourced laboratories for Chemistry, Physics, Biology, and Computer Science/ICT to support practical coursework and research.

Quiet Library & Study Spaces: A quiet, modern library and collaborative study areas designed for peer discussions, research, and independent self-study.

A Legacy of Co-Curricular Excellence, Arts & Sports

At Laiser Hill International School, intellectual growth goes hand-in-hand with creative expression, leadership development, and athletic mastery. 

Creative Arts, Debate & Global Competitions

Award-Winning Performing Arts: Our state-of-the-art Social Hall serves as the hub for creative expression. Laiser Hill has a storied presence at the National Drama Festivals, earning Best National Play (2015) and Best Modern Dance (2023).

International & STEM Platform: Active participation and accolades in Debate, Science Fairs, and the World Scholar’s Cup on both national and international stages.

Regional Sporting Powerhouse

Our campus boasts world-class sporting facilities and elite coaching programs: 

Basketball (The Pinnacle of Excellence): Widely celebrated as East Africa’s premier high school basketball program, with 10 National Championships and 7 East Africa (FEASSSA) Trophies.

Rugby: A dominant force on the pitch with 2 National Titles and 1 East Africa Trophy.

Football: High-performance football training backed by 1 National Championship Trophy. 

Swimming: We have produced best swimmers every at national levels.

Chess and scrabble: We have a vibrant chess and scrabble club

Badminton, lawn tennis and table tennis

Pastoral Care, Guidance & Spiritual Growth

We believe that world-class academic performance requires strong character, mental resilience, and moral grounding:

Guidance & Counseling Department: Highly qualified, empathetic counselors dedicated to student mental health, academic mentoring, and adolescent growth.

Spiritual Leadership: Dedicated chaplaincy and spiritual directors providing moral guidance, reflection, and services for both Christian and Muslim students in an inclusive community.

Step onto a global pathway at Laiser Hill International School—where international accreditation, modern facilities, and a legacy of excellence empower students to reach To Greater Heights.

admission.title: Admissions
admission.article:
Admissions Process

Joining the Laiser Hill Academy Family

At Laiser Hill Academy, we strive to make our admissions journey clear, supportive, and welcoming for every prospective family. Whether you are seeking entry into our Kindergarten, Primary, Junior School, Senior School (CBC & 8-4-4), or International School (Pearson Edexcel IGCSE & A-Levels), our structured process ensures a smooth transition for your child.



1.1. Initial Enquiry: Get in touch.

Reach out to our admissions office via phone, whatsapp, email, or by filling out our online enquiry form. Our team will provide initial details regarding class availability, curriculum pathways, and fee structures.



2.2. Campus Visit & Tour: Experience our grounds.

We invite parents and students to visit our expansive campus along the Nairobi–Magadi Highway. Take a guided tour of our modern ICT and science labs, vast sporting facilities, comfortable dormitories, and vibrant classrooms to experience our learning environment firsthand.



3.3. Learner Assessment & Interview: Oral & written evaluation.

To ensure proper placement and identify your child's academic needs, prospective students undertake a friendly entrance assessment (covering written and/or oral components, depending on the age group and curriculum entry level).



4.4. Official Offer Letter: Securing your place.

Upon successful completion of the assessment, our admissions committee issues a formal Letter of Offer, outlining the allocated class, curriculum path, and fee guidelines.



5.5. Complete Admission Documentation: Finalizing details.

Fill out the comprehensive school admission form, providing necessary student records, medical history, emergency contact details, and previous academic transcripts.



6.6. Fee Payment: Account confirmation.

Complete payment of required admission fees and tuition according to the payment structure outlined in your offer package.



7.7. Admission & Orientation: Welcome to Laiser Hill!.

The student is officially enrolled! We welcome your child on their first day with a comprehensive orientation session to introduce them to their teachers, classmates, and campus routines as they embark on their journey To Greater Heights.



Need Assistance?

Our admissions desk is open Monday to Friday (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM) and Saturdays (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM).
